content.text:
Made these improvements to `0.html`:

- **Mobile viewport fix**: added `100dvh` (with `100vh` fallback) so the layout doesn't get clipped by mobile browser UI chrome.
- **Touch/UX polish**: added `user-select: none` and `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` on the SVG to prevent accidental text selection and the blue tap flash on mobile taps.
- **Accessibility contrast**: bumped the speed label/hint text opacity from 0.7/0.75 to 0.85 for better WCAG contrast readability.
- **SEO/meta**: added a `<meta name="description">` and `color-scheme: dark` so browser UI (scrollbars, form controls) matches the dark theme.

The core animation logic, ARIA setup, and speed-cycling/pause interactions were already solid, so I left those as-is.
